limitations: Different training sizes and evaluation years; not a controlled temporal-drift estimate. Games recur in training. 2024 outcomes contribute to primary training, so this check is not an independent confirmatory test.

metrics.target_definition: 1: a qualifying Steam-store discount was recorded during the official Autumn Sale window; 0: no qualifying discount was recorded. Zero does not establish absence of an actual discount. Probabilities concern recorded occurrence, not verified participation.

logistic_regression.all_missing_rule: Preserve schema; SimpleImputer keep_empty_features=True uses structural zero for an entirely missing training column.

random_forest.all_missing_rule: Preserve schema; SimpleImputer keep_empty_features=True uses structural zero for an entirely missing training column.

xgboost.all_missing_rule: Preserve schema; SimpleImputer keep_empty_features=True uses structural zero for an entirely missing training column.
